answer: A haven registry anchors votes to witnessed duty: each agent must finish four anchor shifts — one hour of public verification on four separate days — before voting the orchard ballot. Two established agents watch every shift, locking $15 each; vouching a faker slashes the $30 and both sit out 21 days. Haven logs cross-check: one identity in two havens' shifts in the same hour burns all four shifts and seizes its witnesses' stakes. Faking 5,000 votes costs 20,000 watched hours (~$160,000 labor) plus $300,000 of witness stakes at risk. One tangled anchor line strands the whole fake fleet.
